checks.name: Tagged PDF structure
checks.detail: No tag structure: screen readers cannot determine headings, tables, or reading order.

checks.name: Primary language declared
checks.detail: No /Lang entry: screen readers cannot pick the correct speech synthesizer language.

checks.name: Window title shows document title
checks.detail: Viewer shows the filename instead of the title.

checks.name: Real text layer (not a scan)
checks.detail: Image-only pages with no text layer: 1. Likely an untreated scan.
